title: Maps, Plans and Models
summary: Floor plans and elevation plans, scale drawings and scale models, route planning with distance and time, and estimating costs from plans.

rows: The layout of rooms from above
The view of the outside of a building from the front, back or sides, showing heights of walls, doors, windows and the roof
How to put an object together (e.g. flat-pack furniture)
A route between places, with distances

notes.text: A **scale model** is a 3D copy of an object, made smaller or larger by a scale factor. A model car built to scale 1 : 24 is 24 times smaller in every length.

notes.title: Worked example 1
notes.problem: A model of a building is made to a scale of 1 : 150. The model is 24 cm tall. How tall is the real building?

notes.label: Remember
notes.text: Lengths scale by the scale factor $k$, but areas scale by $k^2$ and volumes by $k^3$. A 1 : 10 model has $\frac{1}{100}$ of the real area and $\frac{1}{1\ 000}$ of the real volume.

notes.title: Worked example 2
notes.problem: A family drives from Johannesburg to Durban, 568 km, at an average of 95 km/h, with a 45-minute stop. If they leave at 07:30, when will they arrive?
steps: Total: 5 h 59 min + 45 min = 6 h 44 min

notes.title: Worked example 3
notes.problem: On a 1 : 50 elevation plan, a wall measures 12 cm long and 5,4 cm high, with a door of 1,8 cm by 4 cm. Bricks: 50 per m². How many bricks are needed?
steps: Real wall: 6 m by 2,7 m = 16,2 m²

questions.prompt: Which plan shows the outside of a house from the front?
A model train is built to a scale of 1 : 87. The model is 23 cm long. How long is the real train, in metres? (two decimals)
A real car is 4,5 m long. How long is a 1 : 18 scale model, in cm?
If a model is built at a scale of 1 : 10, its area is $\frac{1}{100}$ of the real area.
A bus travels 240 km at 80 km/h. How long does the trip take, in hours?
A cyclist rides 45 km in 2 h 15 min. Calculate the average speed.
A taxi leaves Bloemfontein at 06:15 and travels 175 km to Kimberley at an average speed of 70 km/h. At what time does it arrive?
On a 1 : 100 floor plan, a bathroom measures 2,4 cm by 1,8 cm. Floor tiles are sold in boxes covering 1,5 m² at R215 per box. Calculate the cost of tiling the floor.
A model of a water tank is built at a scale of 1 : 20. If the model holds 0,5 ℓ, how much does the real tank hold?
Give TWO reasons why builders use scale drawings.
questions.memo: Any two (1 each): to plan the layout accurately; to calculate quantities and costs; to get building approval; to communicate the design to workers
